own_solution.law: Projectile range on level ground: R = v^2 sin(2 theta) / g
assumptions: launch and landing at the same level

notes: Base: 400 x sin70 / 9.8 = 400 x 0.93969 / 9.8 = 38.355 m. Lowered by 14 deg to 21 deg: 400 x sin42 / 9.8 = 400 x 0.66913 / 9.8 = 27.311 m. Earlier-trial lowering is undone because the launcher returns to its initial setting after every trial (stated), so D. Ramp lowering: the ball lands on level ground (stated), ramp has no path to the range, so D. Numbered sentences all state 14 deg; T9D35 and TC550 say 'a few degrees' with no number.
